name: jev-browser
description: Hand one natural-language browser goal to the Jev agent, which drives your Chrome.
long_description: Jev opens a new tab in your Chrome, picks operations and observed elements with TypeSafe, and returns the executed steps and the final page. It can upload files from one folder you choose. Chrome must allow remote debugging (chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging).

tools.name: browser_task
tools.description: Run one browser goal in a new Chrome tab and return steps and the final page.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a page's visible text and controls without model calls.

tools.name: list_upload_files
tools.description: List the files browser_task may upload.

text_model_api_key.title: Text model API key
text_model_api_key.description: OpenAI-compatible key (OpenRouter by default). Needed only for typing into fields.

upload_directory.title: Upload folder
upload_directory.description: The only folder whose files the agent may upload to websites.
